name: smwmusic-castlevania-the-last-hour-out-of-time-remix
title: Castlevania - The Last Hour ~ Out of Time (Remix)
description:
Did an arrangement of Out of Time from Castlevania 1. Been a while since I did a Castlevania theme, and I thought I'd do one from the classic early NES game. Surprised a port of this song hasn't been made at all.

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. G Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. F# Minor (Custom Pitch)
